top_sast_rules.cwe_name: Loop with Unreachable Exit Condition ('Infinite Loop')
top_sast_rules.description: A 'for' loop that increments its loop variable but checks it against a lower bound, or decrements its loop variable but checks it against an upper bound, will either stop iterating immediately or keep iterating indefinitely, and is usually indicative of a typo.
